section_title: Money Laundering Risks in Financial Services > Politically exposed person risks

propositions.proposition: PEP的定义涵盖担任重要公职的个人、其直系亲属、密切关联人以及他们控制或持有的企业。
source_quotes: a politically exposed person (PEP) is an individual...
any businesses held or controlled

propositions.proposition: 在识别PEP时，各司法管辖区的指引和建议的差异会导致识别上的挑战。
source_quotes: One challenge in identifying PEPs is the varying guidance

propositions.proposition: 在识别PEP时，机构必须遵守当地监管要求。
source_quotes: Organizations must adhere to their local regulatory requirements in identifying PEPs

propositions.proposition: 基于机构的风险偏好，机构可以选择执行比当地监管要求更高的PEP标准。
source_quotes: organizations may choose to enforce higher standards based on their risk appetite

propositions.proposition: 根据FATF，PEP分为三类：外国PEP（受外国委托担任重要公职的个人）、国内PEP（在国内担任重要公职的个人）和国际组织PEP（在国际组织中担任要职的个人）。
source_quotes: FATF, there are three types of PEPs:
Foreign PEPs...
Domestic PEPs...
International organization PEPs...

propositions.proposition: 高层职位的个人及其关联人更易受到腐败的影响。
source_quotes: Individuals in high positions and their associates are more vulnerable to corruption

propositions.proposition: PEP可能利用其职位进行腐败行为，例如将政府合同导向特定组织以换取回扣、影响立法以收受贿赂或携带政府资金潜逃。
source_quotes: Corruption might be favors where the PEP directs government contracts...
influence legislation for bribes
flee the country with government funds

propositions.proposition: 在定义PEP时，应采用宽泛的定义，涵盖担任重要决策或有影响力角色的人，以及王室、军事、立法、司法、行政等类似政府职位的人。
source_quotes: Use a broad definition for defining a PEP.
A person in a prominent decision-making or influential role
royal, military, legislative, judicial, executive, or similar government positions

propositions.proposition: PEP通常会使用名义人或其关联企业进行活动。
source_quotes: PEPs will often use nominees or businesses they are associated with

propositions.proposition: 鉴于PEP经常使用名义人或关联企业，PEP的定义应扩展到包括直系亲属、密友或关联人，以及这些人拥有或持有的企业。
source_quotes: PEPs will often use nominees...
Therefore, the definition of PEP can also include:
Immediate family
Close friends or associates
Businesses owned or held

propositions.proposition: 在采用基于风险的方法的条件下，PEP相关风险是可控的。
source_quotes: Under a risk-based approach, PEP risk is manageable

propositions.proposition: 即使个人已卸任公职，因可能仍保持相同的影响力圈子，部分机构会采取“一旦是PEP，永远是PEP”的方法，持续将其视为PEP。
source_quotes: Some organizations follow a “once a PEP, always a PEP” approach
may remain in the same circles of influence

propositions.proposition: 其他机构在评估已卸任PEP时，会考察其当前的影响力程度（如授予合同或分配资金的能力）以及被归类为PEP的时间长度，来决定是否继续将其视为PEP。
source_quotes: Other organizations will look at:
individual’s influence at the time
How long the individual has been classified as a PEP

propositions.proposition: PEP认定的目的对风险管理至关重要。
source_quotes: The purpose of the PEP designation is important

propositions.proposition: 机构必须基于其风险偏好，采取必要步骤调整交易监控和KYC审查流程，并进行相应的升级。
source_quotes: Organizations must take the necessary steps to adapt transaction monitoring and KYC reviews and escalate based on their risk appetite
